description:
AIPedometer is a step and workout tracker with AI coaching that runs on your device. No account and no ads. The app never sends your health data to us or to third parties.

STEPS AND GOALS
• Daily steps, distance and goals with Apple Health
• History, streaks and achievements
• Wheelchair push tracking

WORKOUTS
• Workouts with Live Activities, saved back to Apple Health
• GPX routes and Expedition Mode

ON-DEVICE AI
• AI insights, Coach, training plans and smart reminders
• Runs on Apple's on-device model: health context used by AI is not sent to a cloud AI service

EVERYWHERE YOU ARE
• Apple Watch app and widgets

PRIVACY FIRST
• No account, sign-up or login
• No ads and no tracking
• The app never sends health data to us or to third parties

ONE-TIME PURCHASE
• Pay once and get every feature, AI included
• No subscription
• An optional tip in More > Support AI Pedometer supports the app and unlocks nothing

AI features need an iPhone or iPad that supports Apple Intelligence, with it turned on. GPX routes and Expedition Mode work on every supported device. In English and Portuguese.
promotionalText: Track steps, goals and workouts with on-device AI coaching. One-time purchase, no subscription. The app never sends your health data to us or to third parties.
